initial_decision.brief_rationale: The supplied design record provides consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. The observed risk difference, 24/60 − 27/90 = 0.10, is descriptive. Arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification; the requested average causal risk difference is not uniquely determined.
